opening.argument: The presentation promotes paid participation in Bitcoin mining rather than merely discussing the market. It identifies the product as a mining share, advises viewers to buy BTC and get involved with mining, and links investor participation to receiving Bitcoin every day. The slide displays investor mining-share packages with approximate ROI periods, while the speaker describes referral fees, including compensation for later referred shares. Viewers are directed to contact the person who invited them, calculate their budget, and join BitClub. Taken together, the paid packages, daily payout claim, referral structure, and invitation-based enrollment support the conclusion that the offer is presented as a return-generating mining opportunity. The stated returns, payouts, and shortened-link destination are not verified.
